fpProbe.asyncDisclaimer: Gate-1 measures the SYNC stratum only. No broker-mediated async write path exists on this SUT (prep/p3-async-path-resolution.md: verdict NEW-INJECTOR-NEEDED), so no async-FP claim is made; async soundness is deferred to G3 with the Option A injector + P2-completeness validation. Any async fraction reported before that is descriptive-only.

ss-b-card-create.curveNote: points are observable only up to the pre-registered cap (10000 ms); absence beyond the cap is censored, so no larger cutoffs are reported

fpProbe.fpRule: per-run: acknowledged (2xx/success) AND key absent from own read-back at the pre-registered cap = false positive on a benign write

syncFpBar.preRegistered: bar v2: non-timeout-gated sync FP <= 0.05 over >= 20 acked benign runs (plan section 4), evaluable only while the observation gate held (gateResolvedFraction >= 0.5 AND timeoutGatedFraction <= 0.3 — prep/hardening-wave-spec.md section 1)

fpProbe.acceptThenDropTrap: The 2xx-accepted-but-by-design-never-persists trap class has NO representative on TrainTicket: the only by-design drop (contacts dedupe) soft-rejects with body status:0, which the ack rule already excludes (a true negative, not a trap). The residual FP class is therefore covered only by the eventually-consistent-then-correct benign runs measured here.
